Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and a client call after that. You gave my son a zero, and he found out from his phone in the middle of class. Start with why nobody called me.
I didn't come to be thanked. Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
I'm sorry? I have a client call in fifteen minutes, and you're asking me that instead of answering about my son. Why did nobody call me before that zero went in?
If you need to stop, stop. Otherwise, Owen. Why did that zero go in before anyone called me?
